programs.title: Santiago of the Seas
programs.sub_title: Lorelai's Bracelet / Cecelia And The Ghost Ship
programs.desc: Bonnie steals Lorelai's bracelet, turning herself into a mermaid and trapping Lorelai in human form! / Santi and crew must overcome ghostly shenanigans to save Cecilia from the dreaded Ghost Ship.

programs.title: Bluey
programs.desc: The Heeler home is up for sale and Bluey is not happy about it.

programs.title: Nikhil & Jay
programs.sub_title: Nikhil and Jay and the Magic Trick
programs.desc: Nikhil and Jay have planned a magic trick for Jim's birthday, but Nikhil has a nervous monster in his tummy. Can they perform the best trick of all and make the monster disappear?

programs.title: Bananas In Pyjamas
programs.desc: When Rat comes down with a heavy cold, the Bananas step in and do what they always do - they help! Urging Rat to go back to bed, B1 and B2 say they'll be happy to look after his shop for him until he gets better.

programs.title: Sesame Street
programs.sub_title: Sesame Street's Lunar New Year Celebration
programs.desc: Lily, Qui, and Ji-Young are celebrating Lunar New Year on Sesame Street. They share with their friends Elmo, Charlie, Alan, and Grover how their families celebrate the same holiday.

programs.title: Ready, Steady, Wiggle!
programs.desc: The Wiggles are getting ready for Wiggle Town's first air musician band competition! Captain plays the air trumpet, Lachy the air piano, and Caterina, the air flute. What other instruments will they play?

programs.title: Andy and the Band
programs.desc: When Andy loses his voice, that day's gig is thrown into jeopardy. The most unexpected person steps forward to take Andy's place and causes havoc as the band race to get there.

programs.title: Play School: Dance It Out
programs.desc: Are you ready to do the Partayyy Dances? Takaya and Abi are showing each other their favourite party dance moves. Join in and do the Silly Bounce, Giddy, Orange Juice and Floss and party along to Let's All Dance.

programs.title: Numberblocks
programs.desc: Six sings a song about patterns all around us. Patterns - can you spot them all?

programs.title: Peppa Pig
programs.desc: Peppa and George have to tidy their bedroom. Once the room is tidy Mummy says they can go back to their game. The room doesn't stay tidy for long. Peppa's doll and George's dinosaur are at the bottom of the toy box.

programs.title: Peppa Pig
programs.desc: Peppa and George are at the playground. Peppa loves to play on the swings but George doesn't like to be pushed too high. Peppa gets stuck in the tyre on the climbing frame and Daddy Pig gets stuck on the slide.

programs.title: Kiri and Lou
programs.desc: Kiri and Lou want to meet Dalvanius, who is very good at camouflage. He says he'll only reveal himself if they promise not to laugh at his ears.
